remarks: This open, sunny, top-floor Penthouse Condo Home features panoramic views of boats, Veterans Memorial Park, complex pool, Long Island Sound, and Norwalk Harbor! 2bedroom with optional 3rd bedroom/ alcove area adjacent to open concept Livingroom with slider to balcony overlooking LI Sound water views~makes a great guest area/ den/ office space! Large primary bedroom suite has spectacular water views, a full bath, walk-in closet along with two additional closets. Second bedroom has a large walk-in closet with its own private hallway full bathroom. The large extended living room can be used as a 3rd bedroom with the simple installation of a partition! Enjoy the large size crescent curved private terrace with majestic views of the Norwalk Harbor & Long Island Sound under the moonlit skies in the evening! This unit comes with a Covered reserved parking space (with plenty of additional building parking), a storage room located near your parking space, two elevators, party/club room and gorgeous newly redone pool for residents and guests only.  Excellent restaurants nearby and adjacent to building with convenient walk to markets, dinning, ice cream, wine stores, parks, outdoor activities, beaches and much more. Store your Kayaks on site, and dock for water taxi or have friend pick you up! Short walk to SONO & Metro North Train and only 60 minutes to NYC. Life's Better on the Water!!!
